;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syria missile strikes (September 2018)]]
**News emerges that the [[Russia]]n [[Ilyushin Il-20]] aircraft with fourteen people on board, missing since Monday over the [[Mediterranean Sea]], was shot down. Russia accuses [[Israel]] of not giving enough warning before launching its attacks, causing [[Syria]] to shoot the plane down. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45556290 (BBC)] [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-09-18/russian-military-plane-disappears-over-syria/10262896 (ABC News)]

;Business and economy
*[[2018 China–United States trade war]]
**[[China]] adds [[US$]]60 billion of US products to its import [[tariff]] list in retaliation to the [[United States]]' recent tariffs on US$200 billion of Chinese imported goods. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china-response/china-to-penalize-60-billion-of-u-s-imports-in-tit-for-tat-move-idUSKCN1LY22V (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Pacific typhoon season]]
**The death toll of the [[Typhoon Mangkhut]] in the [[Philippines]] rises to 81. 59 others are still missing. [https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2018/09/19/1852867/ompong-death-toll-hits-81-expected-rise (''Philippine Star'')] 
*[[2018 Atlantic hurricane season]], [[Hurricane Florence]] 
**The death toll rises to 35. Also, about 3.4 million chickens and turkeys and 5,500 hogs were killed in flooding from [[Hurricane Florence]] as rising [[North Carolina]] rivers swamped dozens of farm buildings where the animals were being raised for market. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/florences-flooding-claims-3-4-million-poultry-5500-hogs/ (CBS News)] [https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/news/hurricane-florence-death-toll-rises-to-35-evacuees-urged-not-to-return-in-photos (''Washington Examiner'')] 
*[[2016–18 Yemen cholera outbreak]]
**Nine people, including seven children, die from [[cholera]] in [[Yemen]], amid an outbreak of the disease in the country. [https://sputniknews.com/middleeast/201809171068086242-yemen-cholera-edath-toll-health-ministry/ (Sputnik News)]
*A total of 37 people, mostly foreign workers, are confirmed dead due to the drinking of tainted alcohol in [[Malaysia]]. [https://sg.news.yahoo.com/thirty-seven-deaths-across-malaysia-070418680.html (Yahoo News)]
*21 people are killed and 25 others are injured in a collision between a passenger bus and a trailer carrying flammable materials in [[Isfahan]], [[Iran]] [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-09/18/c_137476314.htm (Xinhua)]
*A bus crash in southern [[Ecuador]], leave 12 dead and 27 injured. [http://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/accidente-de-autobus-en-ecuador-deja-12-muertos-y-27-heridos (''El Universal'')]
*The sixth floor of the [[Hotel Ritz, Madrid|Hotel Ritz]] in [[Madrid]], [[Spain]], collapses resulting in the death of one person while 12 others are injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45566448 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[September 2018 inter-Korean summit]], [[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[North Korea]]n [[Supreme Leader of North Korea|leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] greets [[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|President]] [[Moon Jae-in]] in [[Pyongyang]] for their [[2018 inter-Korean summit|third summit meeting in 2018]], as both countries look to establish peace on the [[Korean Peninsula]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/09/17/asia/north-korea-south-korea-summit-intl/ (CNN)]
**North Korea says it will dismantle its [[Yongbyon Nuclear Scientific Research Center]] if the U.S. takes reciprocal measures. North and South Korea say they will seek a joint [[Bids for Olympic Games|bid]] to host the [[2032 Summer Olympics]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/south-korea-s-president-says-north-korea-agrees-dismantle-missile-n910921 (NBC News)]
